Interface Auton

All Known Implementing Classes:
BLineAuton, PathPlannerAuton
public interface Auton

Auton

Used for previewing the selected auton's paths in elastic

The selected path disappears when a different auton is selected or when the robot is enabled

Define an auton in AutonFactory and add it to the auton chooser as shown in the example auton in RobotContainer

Auton routines without paths like characterization routines can be constructed using the noPaths(Command) method
